links.outcome: AI LVO detection sensitivity by occlusion location
links.effect: Sensitivity for anterior circulation LVO was 83.5% [95% CI 76.5-90.5], significantly higher for M1 than for ICA occlusions (95.2% vs. 63.9%, p < 0.01).
links.quote: Artificial intelligence-based sensitivity for anterior circulation LVO detection was 83.5% [95% confidence interval (CI) 76.5-90.5], significantly higher for M1 than for internal carotid artery (ICA) occlusions (95.2% vs. 63.9%, p < 0.01).

unlisted_practices: AI-assisted imaging to support thrombectomy transfer decisions in low-volume primary stroke centers

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the clinical utility, diagnostic sensitivity, and simulated workflow impact of commercial AI software (Brainomix 360) for thrombectomy transfer decisions in low-volume primary stroke centers.
